findings.summary: retireBlockedManifest returns false whenever done/<id>.verdict.json already exists. If a task has both a failed verdict and a blocked manifest, retireFailedVerdict runs first in reconcile and writes the success verdict, so the blocked manifest is skipped and stays in blocked/. Unconfirmed that this board state can occur. It also has no PR-number match against a prior verdict.
